captured_sims: Original char-01/02/03 PNG and animated WebP files retained byte-for-byte. Neutral capture labels replace invented names; descriptions are limited to visible appearance, without personality or backstory claims.
creator_art: New generated creator hero plus original generated full-body creator on About. Neither is a real person photograph or an in-game capture.
garden_art: Five original layers copied unchanged from the read-only mods baseline.
article_covers: Six distinct generated editorial illustrations, clearly labeled. Relevant original gameplay captures also appear inside the articles.
motion: Bounded decorative parallax, manual pause, reduced-motion support and original captured turntables with still-image fallback.
review_state: Revision 22 was published on 10 November 2026. Revision 23 updates visitor-facing copy and browsing while preserving historical evidence and original media.

delivery_optimization.note: Smaller WebP delivery copies only. Original captures and copied source artwork remain unchanged.

editorial_changes: Original article meaning and test results retained; clipped copy and dead-end image referrals revised, and the park article links to the later completed tests.
mod_test_scope: The development target is The Sims 4 1.105. The dated 28/28 result applies only to the MoveAnywhere park-move scenario; it is not a collection-wide compatibility result. Existing per-mod statuses remain unchanged.
shared_template: Every route uses the same garden masthead, six primary tabs, display controls, window chrome and footer. Interior content shares a 1200px outer shell and a 72ch article reading measure.
plumbob: Animated emerald with cached gradient glow cards; capped at 30fps and 1.5 DPR on desktop, 15fps and 1 DPR on mobile. Paused, reduced-motion, hidden and offscreen states stop the animation.
article_reading_order: Each of the six posts opens with its unchanged introductory paragraph before the cover illustration, then continues with the remaining original prose and evidence. Responsive delivery preserves the full original cover fallback.
art_direction: Shared page geometry with topic-specific accents, compact project artwork, two additional transparent illustrations and direct project links. Existing art and real captures remain preserved.
additional_creator_art: Distinct note-writing, thoughtful, TV-corner, heart-hug and wayfinding poses, plus a gift-courier robot. Original props remain in the compositions. The supplied MoveAnywhere graphic remains unchanged, beside its existing explanation on wide screens.
character_file_access: Original animation and still-image links remain available without JavaScript or native dialog support; supported browsers enhance normal animation-link clicks into the existing viewer.
capture_viewer: Original screenshot links gain a keyboard-accessible viewer with fit/zoom and scroll inspection. With JavaScript unavailable they remain direct file links. Generated artwork is not included in the capture viewer.
mod_card_reading_order: Each smaller mod card starts with its existing name, status and purpose, followed by the unchanged promotional artwork and labelled actual game capture.
layer_kit_reuse: All 20 layer-kit PNGs match the preserved original mod-site WebPs by decoded pixels. Two unused, text-free botanical layers now frame the shared footer in a separate decorative area. Baked-text interface images are not used, and existing animated jewels/controls remain intact.

thumbnail_delivery.note: Responsive image delivery for devlog cards and article covers, ornaments, reading links and promotional mod art. Full artwork remains the fallback; original cover files are unchanged.

copy_and_browsing: Seven existing mod anchors have a compact jump list. Three tested/fixed projects link directly to their existing devlogs. Availability and remaining historical safety/stat wording are clarified without adding release promises or changing game evidence.
visitor_copy: Player-facing introductions and mod descriptions; unreleased availability remains explicit. Technical test history stays in the devlogs.
